readerQuestion: What information helps Dreemy support understand a login failure without exposing private information?

applicableClaims.name: Dreemy AI Contact Us
applicableClaims.note: The public support page accepts login and technical issues and asks for the associated account email, device information and useful error images.

applicableClaims.name: Dreemy AI Privacy Policy
applicableClaims.note: The collection section identifies inputs, outputs and technical data. The safety section says not to place personally identifiable information in public bots or prompts.

illustration.alt: Three points to distinguish during login troubleshooting: the sign-in page, the return from the sign-in provider, and the account screen.

editorialReview.readerAction: Record where a login attempt stopped and prepare a support note that leaves passwords, verification codes and chat text out.
editorialReview.factBasis: Primary sources and an explicitly fictional example. No product operation is claimed.
editorialReview.productionReview: The compiled Worker, all release boundaries and formal site are checked separately.
